name: Link
description:
A text link: in a sentence, on its own line, or a quiet name in a table. Links go
somewhere; actions that change something are Buttons (ButtonLink when a button must
navigate).
signature: ({ variant, newTab, external, icon, disabled, render, labels, className, children, href, ...rest }: LinkProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A link that cannot be followed now: no href, `aria-disabled`, muted.

props.name: external
props.description: Show the external mark without opening a new tab. Default: on with `newTab`.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading icon, sized to the text.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ readonly newTab: "(opens in a new tab)"; }> | undefined

props.name: newTab
props.description: Open in a new tab: adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, an external mark and "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers.

props.name: render
props.description: A router's link element (`<RouterLink to="…" />`); its routing props, ref and handlers are kept.

props.name: variant
props.description: The named visual variant. It is rendered as a data attribute and styled through shared tokens.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
